description: This file implements generic infrastructure for reference iterators in a Git-related project, including various iterator types, their initialization, advancement, seeking, and release functions, as well as specific iterator behaviors like overlay and prefix filtering.

classes.name: struct ref_iterator
classes.description: Base structure for reference iterators, containing a vtable and reference data.

classes.name: struct empty_ref_iterator
classes.description: A simple reference iterator that is always empty.

classes.name: struct merge_ref_iterator
classes.description: An iterator that merges two other reference iterators, with custom selection logic.

classes.name: struct prefix_ref_iterator
classes.description: An iterator that filters references based on a prefix, optionally trimming the prefix from reference names.

methods.name: ref_iterator_advance
methods.description: Advances the reference iterator to the next reference.

methods.name: ref_iterator_seek
methods.description: Seeks the reference iterator to a specific reference name.

methods.name: ref_iterator_free
methods.description: Frees the reference iterator and releases associated resources.

methods.name: empty_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Creates a new empty reference iterator.

methods.name: is_empty_ref_iterator
methods.description: Checks if a reference iterator is the empty iterator.

methods.name: merge_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Creates a new iterator that merges two reference iterators with a selection function.

methods.name: overlay_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Creates an iterator that overlays one reference iterator on top of another.

methods.name: prefix_ref_iterator_begin
methods.description: Creates an iterator that filters references by a prefix, with optional trimming.

methods.name: do_for_each_ref_iterator
methods.description: Iterates over all references in an iterator, applying a callback function.
